ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe: Large contiguous white field extending from the peduncle to the sub-terminal region, bordered by thick black margins. Right lobe: Large central white patch isolated by thick black borders. Transitions between light and dark zones feature significant pixel mottling and stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch; pixel-calculated angle of approximately 58 degrees with a depth occupying roughly 15% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge (top boundary); peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies between 3 and 10 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve following the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips; the left lobe displays a more elongated lateral taper than the right.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Primary cluster of approximately 10-15 high-contrast, circular white/tan features (consistent with barnacle colonization) at the leftmost terminal tip. Minor secondary cluster visible at the rightmost tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel, vertically oriented dark-intensity linear disruptions observed within the central high-intensity patch of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization at the distal edge of the left lobe; irregular, ragged topography along the trailing edge of the right lobe suggesting minor physical trauma or environmental wear.
